## **Unlock** your creative potential with our leading capabilities

- [Upgrade your creativity](https://one.google.com/ai?utm_source=gemini&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=advmktgsite)

## Write the scene you want to watch

Generate high quality videos with our video generation models. Simply describe what you have in mind and watch your ideas come to life in motion– whether you're creating for fun, sharing with friends, or adding a dynamic element to your projects. Just describe it and Gemini will create it.

![](https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-gemini-cdn/gemini/uploads/48914768735a691f9b3f09313811f13476bc6b54.svg)

Your ideas generator

## Create more efficiently

With more access access to our leading model, **3.1 Pro**, you can develop more impactful content strategies, streamline your workflows, concept new creative formats, and explore new ways to captivate your audience with a next-gen collaborative partner.

![](https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-gemini-cdn/gemini/uploads/48914768735a691f9b3f09313811f13476bc6b54.svg)

Your ideas generator

## Expand your horizons

Work on a larger canvas than ever before with up to **1,500 pages of file uploads**. Leverage your existing assets, industry research, video transcripts, and more to generate new content ideas for any platform – like comprehensive blog posts, social captions, and website pages.

## Frequently asked questions

What is Google AI Pro?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

Level-up your Gemini app experience by upgrading to the Pro plan. Unlock new and powerful features to tackle complex tasks and projects.

Get more access to our most capable models, like 3.1 Pro, and powerful features, like Deep Research and a 1M token context window. Also, unlock a limited trial of Veo 3.1 Lite, our video generation model that prioritizes speed and efficiency.

Our [Google AI Pro plan](https://one.google.com/ai?utm_source=gemini&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=faq) is available for over 18 users and also includes:

- Gemini in Gmail, Docs, and more

- 5 TB of cloud storage

- and other benefits

You also need a personal Google Account that you manage on your own.

[How to upgrade](https://one.google.com/ai?utm_source=gemini&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=faq)

What is Google AI Ultra?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

Get the best of Gemini by upgrading to the Ultra plan. Unlock the highest level of access to our most powerful features like video generation with Veo 3.1, Deep Research, audio overviews, and our most capable AI models, like 3.1 Pro. You’ll also get priority access to try our newest AI innovations as they become available, including Agent Mode.

Google AI Ultra includes everything in Google AI Pro, plus more. Google AI Ultra is available for over 18 users and also includes:

- Gemini in Gmail, Docs, and more

- Starting at 20 TB of cloud storage

- Gemini Notebook

- and other benefits

You also need a personal Google Account that you manage on your own.

[How to upgrade](https://one.google.com/ai?utm_source=gemini&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=faq)

Will Google AI Pro work in the Gemini mobile app?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

Yes, however, there might be some feature differences between the Gemini mobile app and Gemini web app. [How to upgrade](https://one.google.com/ai?utm_source=gemini&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=faq)

If you want to manage your Google AI subscription in the mobile app, tap your profile picture to access the **Settings** menu.

## Frequently asked questions

What is Gemini Enterprise and what does it do?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

[Gemini Enterprise](https://cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise/?utm_source=gemini.google&utm_medium=et&utm_campaign=gemini-app-website-subscriptions&utm_content=business-faq) is an advanced agentic platform that brings the best of Google AI to every employee, for every workflow. It empowers teams to discover, create, share, and run AI agents—all in one secure environment.

Gemini Enterprise makes it simple to generate sales and financial reports, create marketing content, accelerate developer productivity, and more—all from simple prompts grounded in your business data.

What are the differences between Gemini Enterprise editions?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

Gemini Enterprise offers multiple editions to fit the unique needs of your organization.  
**Business edition**: Great for small businesses and teams up to 300—no IT setup needed.  
**Standard and Plus editions**: Designed for organizations that need stricter security and compliance requirements. Includes higher quota, unlimited seats, and access to third-party agents.

Who owns the data and does Google use my data for training models?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

The Business, Standard and Plus editions of Gemini Enterprise are built on Google’s secure-by-design infrastructure, giving you the peace of mind to deploy AI agents across your organization confidently.

- You own your data, not Google

- Your data—including prompts, outputs, and training—isn’t used to train Google models or models for any other customer

- Google never sells customer data to third parties

- Google doesn’t use customer data for advertising
